patthana24.6:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi. na hetuṃ na
patthana24.6:2.1: ārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu ārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
patthana24.6:3.1: na hetuṃ no cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:4.1: na hetuṃ na no cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu no citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:5.1: na hetuṃ na cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu cetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi,
patthana24.6:6.1: na hetuṃ na acetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu acetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:7.1: na hetuṃ na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu cittasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:8.1: na hetuṃ na cittavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu cittavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.6:9.1: na hetuṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetucittasaṃsaṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.

patthana24.6:12.1: cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu no cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
